title: 第十一章 拿下折花公子第十二章 大收获
content_zh:
“我姓王，单名一个昱字。”王昱自我介绍，然后指指车厢中的李云岫，“这是内子李氏。”
“王兄！嫂夫人！”
互相通了姓名，牛车继续前进，此时距离普宁县已经不远了，又走了小半个时辰，就看到了普宁县的夯土城墙。
“方师兄！”
刚来到城门口，就有一位身穿碧青长衫，手持长剑的太华派弟子从旁边茶馆钻出来。
“林师弟。”
“这是我师弟林知远。”方少白给王昱介绍，然后又对林知远道，“王兄乃是与我一见如故的好友。”
“见过王兄！见过嫂夫人！”林知远很有礼貌，心中也颇讶异。
方少白平日里洒脱不羁，看起来平易近人，和谁都能交朋友，但能被他称作一见如故，可是从来没有的事。
“那个什么折花公子还在普宁县吗？”方少白问道，“怎么还把宏照大师也给招来了？”
“在，昨夜他夜袭许家，虽然许家小姐无事，但许家主还是被他一掌打中胸口，吐血受伤。”
林知远回道，“宏照大师是为他徒弟来的，他徒弟法竹乃是周家的远房亲戚，前些日子正在金狮堡做客，遇到折花公子时仗义出手，却被对方重伤。
宏照大师闻讯后一路寻迹赶来，追到了普宁县，昨夜还和折花公子交了手，但留不下对方。”
“哦？”方少白有些惊讶，“宏照大师也留不下对方，这采花贼的武功可以啊！”
“主要是宏照大师的轻功不如对方。”林知远道，“那折花公子确实轻功高妙，可凌空腾挪，避过了宏照大师的金刚掌力，远遁而去。”
方少白点点头，“先进城吧，我路上遇到卷毛熊，听他说城里还有其他狠茬子？”
林知远引着牛车进城，同时回答方少白，“还有金刀客段平，铁掌开山孟崇虎，南山双杰江氏兄弟。
段平和孟崇虎有旧怨，昨日他们在西街打了一架，毁了七八间店铺，最后还是被宏照大师劝住的。”
方少白了然点头，“怪不得卷毛熊躲出去了。”
卷毛熊在普宁县开堂口立规矩收保护费，同时也负责保护这些商户不会被偷被抢被找事，但金刀客和铁掌开山显然超出了他的能力范围，所以他只能躲出去。

“他们都是为了赵昱而来吗？看来京城开的悬赏不少。”方少白调侃道，“南山双杰一向自诩正道大侠，没想到也来趟这浑水。”
林知远笑道，“江氏兄弟昨天还说他们不是为了花红，而是为民除害。”
几人回到客栈，这里还有太华派的另一位年轻弟子魏岩，他和林知远轮换着在城东门迎接方少白，此时正在客栈睡觉。
看到来的是方少白，魏岩兴高采烈，“师兄来了，那折花公子死定了！”
方少白摆摆手，“少拍马屁，说说现在的情况吧。”
魏岩好奇的看向凑在旁边专心倾听，一点都没有离开意思的王昱三人。
方少白摇头道，“王兄见识广博，说不定能给咱们出出主意。”
既然方少白同意，魏岩便直接说道，“折花公子在金狮堡得手之后，放言要将普宁县三个武林世家的小姐都睡了，然后他就真的来到了普宁县。”
林知远接话，“我和魏师弟正好就在普宁县，昨天与他照了一面，不是他的对手，于是派人向师门求助。”
普宁县在函谷府，算是太华派的势力范围，许家等三个武林小世家包括金狮堡每年节庆都会向太华派送礼，也算某种意义上的保护费。
太华派的年轻弟子也多在函谷府行侠，所以才能及时遇上。
“我正巧距离普宁县不远，途中截住了那人。”方少白说道。
林知远恍然，“怪不得师兄来的这么早，我还以为师门支援能在明日来就不错了。”
魏岩说道，“我和林师兄都做好了今天晚上各自去罗家和刘家守夜的打算。”
方少白点点头，“但我不知道那折花公子今晚去哪家。”
林知远说道，“要不和宏照大师商量一下，你们两位一人一家？”
就在此时，王昱突然问道，“他昨天在许家不是没得手吗？你们为什么觉得他不会再回许家？”
魏岩下意识道，“宏照大师昨夜就在许家，他今晚怎敢还……”
“嗯？”
方少白三人都反应过来，宏照大师今晚如果去刘家或者罗家的话，许家可就没人了，折花公子未必猜不到这点。

“我和魏师弟留在许家。”林知远说道。
方少白摇了摇头，看向王昱，“王兄可有指教？”
王昱摩挲着下巴，询问林知远，“许家、罗家、刘家都在城中何处？”
林知远答道，“许家在城北，罗家和刘家都在城南，倒是相距不远。”
就在这时，店伙敲响了房门，“林大侠、魏大侠，楼下有大金刚寺的禅师找你们。”
content_en:
"My surname is Wang, with the character Yu." Wang Yu introduced himself, then pointed to Li Yunxiu in the carriage, "This is my wife, Mrs. Li."
"Brother Wang! Madam Sister-in-law!"
After exchanging names, the ox cart continued to move forward. It was not far from Puning County. After walking for less than half an hour, we saw the rammed earth city wall of Puning County.
"Senior Brother Fang!"
As soon as they arrived at the gate of the city, a Taihua disciple wearing a green gown and holding a long sword came out of the teahouse next to him.
"Junior Brother Lin."
"This is my junior brother Lin Zhiyuan." Fang Shaobai introduced to Wang Yu, and then said to Lin Zhiyuan, "Brother Wang is a good friend who I fell in love with at first sight."
"I've met Brother Wang! I've met Madam Sister-in-law!" Lin Zhiyuan was very polite, but also quite surprised.
Fang Shaobai was usually free and uninhibited, seemed approachable, and could make friends with anyone, but he had never been able to say that he felt like old friends at first sight.
"Is that Mr. Zhehua still in Puning County?" Fang Shaobai asked, "Why did you also recruit Master Hongzhao?"
"Here, last night he attacked the Xu family at night. Although Miss Xu's family was fine, the head of the Xu family was hit in the chest by his palm and he vomited blood and was injured."
Lin Zhiyuan replied, "Master Hongzhao is here for his apprentice. His apprentice Fazhu is a distant relative of the Zhou family. He was a guest at the Golden Lion Castle a few days ago. When he met Mr. Zhehua, he acted righteously, but was seriously injured by him.
After hearing the news, Master Hongzhao came all the way to Puning County. He even fought against Mr. Zhehua last night, but he couldn't leave him alone. "
"Oh?" Fang Shaobai was a little surprised, "Master Hongzhao can't keep him, but this flower picker's martial arts can do it!"
"The main reason is that Master Hongzhao's Qinggong is not as good as the other's." Lin Zhiyuan said, "That Master Zhehua is indeed very good in Qinggong, but he can fly in the air and avoid Master Hongzhao's Vajra Palm power, and escape far away."
Fang Shaobai nodded, "Let's go to the city first. I met a curly bear on the way. I heard from him that there are other ruthless people in the city?"
Lin Zhiyuan led the oxcart into the city and answered Fang Shaobai at the same time, "There is also Duan Ping, the Golden Swordsman, Meng Chonghu, the founder of the Iron Palm Mountain, and the Jiang brothers, the two outstanding heroes of Nanshan.
Duan Ping and Meng Chonghu had an old grudge. They had a fight on West Street yesterday and destroyed seven or eight shops. In the end, Master Hongzhao persuaded them to stop. "
Fang Shaobai nodded clearly, "No wonder the Curly Bear hid away."
Curly Bear established rules in Puning County to collect protection fees, and was also responsible for protecting these merchants from being stolen, robbed, and causing trouble. However, the Golden Swordsman and Iron Palm Kaishan were obviously beyond his ability, so he had no choice but to hide out.
"Are they all here for Zhao Yu? It seems that the capital offers a lot of rewards." Fang Shaobai joked, "The two heroes of Nanshan have always regarded themselves as righteous heroes, but I didn't expect to come to this troubled water."
Lin Zhiyuan smiled and said, "The Jiang brothers said yesterday that they were not doing this for bonuses, but for eliminating harm for the people."
Several people returned to the inn, where there was another young disciple of the Taihua sect, Wei Yan. He and Lin Zhiyuan took turns greeting Fang Shaobai at the east gate of the city, and were sleeping in the inn at this time.
Seeing that it was Fang Shaobai who was coming, Wei Yan was very happy, "Senior brother is here, that Young Master Zhehua is dead!"
Fang Shaobai waved his hand, "Stop flattering me and tell me about the current situation."
Wei Yan looked curiously at Wang Yu and the other three who were listening intently and showed no intention of leaving.
Fang Shaobai shook his head and said, "Brother Wang is knowledgeable and might be able to give us some advice."
Since Fang Shaobai agreed, Wei Yan said directly, "After Mr. Zhehua succeeded in the Golden Lion Castle, he promised to sleep with all the ladies from Puning County's martial arts families, and then he actually came to Puning County."
Lin Zhiyuan answered, "Junior Brother Wei and I happened to be in Puning County. We had a photo with him yesterday and found that we were no match for him, so we sent someone to ask for help from the sect."
Puning County is in Hangu Prefecture, which is considered the sphere of influence of the Taihua Sect. The Xu family and three other small martial arts families, including the Golden Lion Castle, will pay homage to them every year during festivals.Gifts given by the Taihua faction can also be regarded as protection fees in a sense.
Most of the young disciples of the Taihua sect are also practicing knights in Hangu Mansion, so they can meet them in time.
"I happened to be not far from Puning County, and I intercepted the man on the way." Fang Shaobai said.
Lin Zhiyuan suddenly realized, "No wonder senior brother came so early. I thought it would be good if support from the sect can come tomorrow."
Wei Yan said, "Senior Brother Lin and I have made plans to go to the Luo Family and Liu Family to keep vigil tonight."
Fang Shaobai nodded, "But I don't know where that young man will go tonight."
Lin Zhiyuan said, "Why don't you discuss it with Master Hongzhao and let the two of you live together?"
At this moment, Wang Yu suddenly asked, "Didn't he fail at the Xu family yesterday? Why do you think he will not return to the Xu family again?"
Wei Yan subconsciously said, "Master Hongzhao was at Xu's house last night. How dare he return tonight..."
"Huh?"
Fang Shaobai and the three of them all realized that if Master Hongzhao went to the Liu family or the Luo family tonight, there would be no one in the Xu family. Mr. Zhehua might not have guessed this.
"Junior brother Wei and I stayed in the Xu family." Lin Zhiyuan said.
Fang Shaobai shook his head and looked at Wang Yu, "Brother Wang, can you give me some advice?"
Wang Yu rubbed his chin and asked Lin Zhiyuan, "Where are the Xu family, Luo family, and Liu family in the city?"
Lin Zhiyuan replied, "The Xu family is in the north of the city, and the Luo family and Liu family are in the south of the city. They are not far apart."
At this moment, the shopkeeper knocked on the door, "Daxia Lin, Daxia Wei, there is a Zen master from the Great Vajra Temple downstairs looking for you."
